story.title: ‘GenZ against addiction’: PM Modi launches 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan' — Explained
story.summary: PM Modi launched the ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan’ at 11 am on August 2, 2026. He called upon young Indians to take the pledge against substance abuse and participate in 100 weeks of awareness and community activities to build a drug-free India.
